verdict.rationale: Replit docs show first-party support for adding server-side functionality (databases, auth, deployments) and third-party integrations including Stripe payments and 100+ services via MCP connectors, plus built-in auth/database provisioning without leaving the builder. Community evidence corroborates general functionality but doesn't specifically test payments/email integrations. Missing for 10: independent hands-on verification of a payments/email integration working end-to-end, and explicit email-sending capability documentation.
